visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a low-angle shot of a light-colored wooden hallway. A tabby cat's head is visible, peeking around a white corner in the far background. The lighting is bright and even, indicating a modern indoor residential setting. (2) The cat walks forward into the hallway, moving directly towards the camera. It is a brown and black striped tabby with a focused expression. The white walls are plain, and a small built-in shelf with various items is visible on the left wall. (3) The cat reaches the end of the hallway and enters an open living area. A multi-level beige carpeted cat tree is prominent in the foreground, adorned with several plush toys, including a green turtle and a brown creature. The cat moves with a calm, curious gait. (4) A person's hand, wearing a white sleeve and featuring a small tattoo on the wrist, enters the frame to pet the cat's head and neck. The cat reacts by looking up with large green eyes and slightly tilting its head. (5) The cat jumps onto the middle tier of the cat tree and settles down. It gazes toward the camera and the hallway behind it. In the distant background, a dining table and chairs are partially visible, suggesting a spacious apartment layout.
